installationLifecycle.target_resolution: Agent resolves its own Skill directory; pass --agent and --path
installationLifecycle.verification: CLI entry/version and managed Skill current=true; partial installation is incomplete

input.references: ordered PNG/JPEG/WebP local files or HTTPS URLs

output.terminal: local MP4 + saved Frame containing original reference nodes and one video node

generationTransport.concurrency: separate conversations in the same tab; queued UI submissions and canvas writes; parallel remote runs
generationTransport.recovery: saved sessionId/runId; read-only run and history APIs

dependencies.browser: Installed Google Chrome; built-in macOS/Windows discovery and startup on loopback 9223 with current-user dedicated profile

platforms.codex:macos: tested: six native Agent video tasks across two boards; one tab per board; downloads, deduplication and Frame readback verified
platforms.generic:windows: built-in Chrome discovery/startup implemented; actual host video end-to-end verification pending

install.output: Verified CLI and current Agent companion Skill; complete=true only when both are ready

video generate.externalMutation: With --submit: import references, send native Agent conversation, import a missing video, group selected elements in a Frame.
video generate.paid: Only native webpage sending may charge credits.

task get|wait|resume|sync.externalMutation: resume continues original task; sync reapplies existing video archival and grouping; never a second generation.

frame group.externalMutation: With --submit: reparent existing nodes and preserve their identities.

browser status.output: Chrome availability and separate CDP runtime readiness

browser open.externalMutation: Launch or reuse system Chrome on loopback 9223 with the current-user dedicated profile; no generation.

automaticUpdates.trigger: ordinary video/frame/doctor/capabilities entry; excludes help/version/skill/task polling
automaticUpdates.recovery: offline backoff preserves installation; source checkout updates through Git; explicit install keeps a package backup

limitations: No service-side atomic canvas revision check; stop on detected user edits.
Frame grouping first version supports unrotated image/video nodes.
Do not submit another generation after unknown submission.
